therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: dopaminergic and serotonergic modulation to reduce psychotic and negative symptoms
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with schizophrenia and prominent negative symptoms who completed the prior 6-month trial (A7501013)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in NSA scale total score at Day 365

results.effect_size: asenapine -15.8 vs olanzapine -11.0 (least squares mean change in NSA total score)
subgroup_findings: Asenapine showed greater improvement in NSA total score (-15.8) vs olanzapine (-11.0) at Day 365 (p=0.0148)
QLS total score improvement was similar between asenapine (12.4) and olanzapine (11.7) at Day 365 (p=0.8100)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were infrequent; schizophrenia relapse was the most common SAE in the olanzapine arm (3/110)
Hyponatraemia, alcohol abuse, psychotic disorder, and schizophrenia paranoid type each occurred in 1/85 asenapine patients

dose_info.schedule: asenapine twice daily sublingually; olanzapine once daily orally

context.duration: 26 weeks (extension; 52 weeks total from A7501013 baseline)
